hooks.command: bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/hook_session_start.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/hook_session_start.sh"; else bash "hooks/hook_session_start.sh"; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/hook_prompt_submit.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/hook_prompt_submit.sh"; else bash "hooks/hook_prompt_submit.sh"; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/hook_stop.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/hook_stop.sh"; else bash "hooks/hook_stop.sh"; fi'

bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/windows_notification.ps1" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ".claude/hooks/windows_notification.ps1" -Title "Copilot Hooks" -EventType stop; else powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "hooks/windows_notification.ps1" -Title "Copilot Hooks" -EventType stop; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/hook_task_complete.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/hook_task_complete.sh"; else bash "hooks/hook_task_complete.sh"; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/hook_pre_tool_branch_guard.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/hook_pre_tool_branch_guard.sh"; else bash "hooks/hook_pre_tool_branch_guard.sh"; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/memory-observe.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/memory-observe.sh" pre; else bash "hooks/memory-observe.sh" pre; fi'
bash -lc 'if [ -f ".claude/hooks/memory-observe.sh" ]; then bash ".claude/hooks/memory-observe.sh" post; else bash "hooks/memory-observe.sh" post; fi'
